statement: Written successors only: genus2 Riemann-Roch gives unique rational degree2 effective support for nonzero rational classes, enabling a fixed-field point-correspondence chain in3+3/6 sectors; same-field monic normalization and raw-dual characteristic3 minus2 control are derived. A250-equation bielliptic plane-quartic F5 family is proposed for a genuine genus3 Jacobian/elliptic-factor source, with explicit smoothness/Weil/twist/mutation controls. No such second-chain or plane-quartic experiment, actual J4 bridge or computational advantage has run.
